changedFiles.reason: Switched the default runtime store factory from FileThreadStore to SqliteThreadStore for the shared PI extension path.
Updated compatibility `writeTurns` and `writeChunks` to diff/update rows transactionally instead of deleting whole tables, preserving stable rows during cutover.
Added regression coverage proving SQLite compatibility writes preserve existing turn/chunk rows while accepting whole-array callers.
Moved default-store command smoke coverage onto SQLite-backed managed threads and default extension wiring.
Added SQLite runtime capture coverage for default extension capture, idempotent duplicate suppression, reopen, and no-legacy-source-file assertions.
Added post-cutover attach/import coverage that writes canonical imported session state into SQLite-backed managed threads.
Added a focused PI extension runtime smoke proving default handler registration and status commands work against SQLite-backed state.
Updated CLI E2E expectations and inspections from legacy thread JSON files to SQLite-backed managed state.
Updated long-thread real-runtime E2E coverage to import prepared clones into SQLite before execution and inspect the SQLite-backed source of truth.
